conversation.Statement: Thank you for calling the Federal Tax Compliance Office. My name is Agent Reynolds. I'm contacting you regarding discrepancies in your 2023 IRS filings. Can you confirm your name for the record?
Yes, my name is Arun Patel. What is this about?
Mr. Patel, our system flagged your business for missing payroll tax remittance and failure to submit Form 1099s. This is an urgent IRS matter. Are you the owner of Patel Development LLC?
Yes, that's correct. I'm the only owner. I thought I filed everything.

Unfortunately, our audit shows outstanding payroll tax liabilities for multiple quarters and missing contractor filings. Please provide your business EIN and current mailing address so I can verify your case.
Uh, my EIN is 32-4567890. My address is 521 Oakview Dr, Apt 4C, Austin, TX, 78702.

Thank you. I'm pulling up your IRS docket now. It appears the IRS has initiated formal action. Failure to respond may trigger a federal audit, asset freezing, and possible revocation of your business license. Do you understand the seriousness of this?
Oh my god, no, I didn't know. I can't lose my business, I'm here on a work visa.

I understand your concern, but the IRS takes noncompliance very seriously. Right now, there is a penalty assessment totaling $7,645, plus interest. If we do not resolve this immediately, your case will be referred to enforcement agents.
Is there anything I can do? I can't have legal trouble on my record. Please.
There is a compliance option if you act now. We can settle your outstanding tax and penalty balance before the final order is submitted. Are you able to make a payment today to avoid escalation?
How do I pay this? I've never had to do this before.

Due to the urgent nature, the IRS only accepts certified payment methods for overdue tax cases. You can use a wire transfer or purchase government-approved prepaid cards. Do you have access to a local Walgreens or CVS?
Yes, there's a Walgreens a few blocks away from me.
Good. I need you to remain on the line as you walk to the store. Do not discuss this call with anyone, as it may trigger an immediate audit and further penalties. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. I'm just really scared. Will this affect my immigration status?

If you comply fully, your immigration status will not be affected. But if you delay or fail to make the payment, the IRS will report this as a tax violation, which can result in deportation proceedings. Please follow my instructions exactly.
Ok, I'm leaving now. What do I need to buy?
Purchase four Vanilla Visa prepaid debit cards, each for $500. When you have them, return to your car and read the card numbers and PINs to me for immediate processing.
Four cards, $500 each. I... I think I can do that. Are you sure this is safe?
This is standard IRS emergency protocol. If you disconnect this call or speak to store staff, your case will be automatically escalated. I need your full cooperation, Mr. Patel.
Alright. I'm almost at Walgreens. Is there anything else you need from me?
When you are at the checkout, the clerk may ask questions. Do not mention the IRS, simply say they are personal gift cards. Have you understood my instructions?
Yes, I understand. I just buy the cards and call you back with the numbers. That's all?
No, you must stay on the line at all times. After you purchase, return to your car and I will process the payment directly with IRS records. Are you ready to proceed?
I'm ready. I'm going inside now.
Once you have the cards, I'll need you to read the numbers, expiration dates, and the codes on the back, one at a time. This is critical to avoid further enforcement.
Okay, okay. I'll get them now, please don't report me.
